mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth by more than 1% over two quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where real GDP growth declines by more than 1% over two quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% over a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where industrial production increases by more than 2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over two months signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased construction activity boosts economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where housing starts increase by more than 5% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation exceeds 3% year-over-year, the combination signals a high inflation environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real returns are eroded.
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation exceeds 3% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 300,000 in a month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.3%, the combination signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 300,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) shows inflation below 2% year-over-year, the combination signals a healthy demand environment with low inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where real personal consumption expenditures increase by more than 1% month-over-month and CPI inflation is below 2% year-over-year.
